components.component:
(css) /* ==== Overlays, lists and content ==== */

/* Overlays: Dialog, Sheet, AlertDialog. React Aria portals them to the end
   of the document, so they take the document's tokens. The scrim mixes
   the darkest neutral into transparency, which darkens the page in both
   themes; there is no semantic scrim token yet. Widths are multiples of
   the space scale, as there are no dimension tokens. The z-index lifts the
   overlay over the raised options of a choice group. */
.stoa-overlay

tokens.name: --stoa-font-family-mono
tokens.value: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Noto Sans Arabic', ui-monospace, monospace
tokens.resolvedValue: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Noto Sans Arabic', ui-monospace, monospace

tokens.name: --stoa-font-family-sans
tokens.value: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif
tokens.resolvedValue: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif

components.component:
(css) /* A running step's symbol breathes in size, not in opacity, so its
   contrast never drops; it stands still under reduced motion, which sets
   the duration token to zero. */
.stoa-step__status--running .stoa-step__symbol
